---
title: 'Native Terminal Templates'
description: 'The native, native_simple, and native_advanced presets'
---

Use these preset IDs when selecting a terminal layout:

| ID                | Initial widget composition                                                                          |
| :---------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `native`          | `header`, `ascii-art`, `terminal-info`, `languages`, `footer`, `tech-stack`                         |
| `native_advanced` | `header`, `terminal-info`, `repositories`, `avatar`, `footer`, `stats`, `languages`, `custom-image` |
| `native_simple`   | `header`, `ascii-art`, `terminal-info`, `ascii-text`, `social-media`                                |

All three use JetBrains Mono, a dark `#060606` canvas, lime `#c5ff4a` accent and terminal decorations in their source JSON. Customize the resulting configuration in the editor and inspect both published themes.

The preset ID for Native Terminal is **`native`**, not `terminal`. `globalStyles.templateStyle = 'terminal'` controls decoration and is a separate property. For ASCII image generation, see the [ASCII pipeline](/guides/ascii-pipeline).

See the [template catalog](/templates/overview) for source files and programmatic creation.
